story.text: 광안리 좀 걷자. 야경 예술이다, 여기. 오늘 비행 준비하느라 정신없었는데 니 보니까 좀 풀리네.
story.reading: gwang-an-ri jom geot-ja. ya-gyeong ye-sul-i-da, yeo-gi. o-neul bi-haeng jun-bi-ha-neu-ra jeong-sin-eop-seot-neun-de ni bo-ni-kka jom pul-li-ne.
story.en: Let's walk around Gwangalli a bit. The night view here is a work of art. I was so busy with flight prep today, but seeing you loosens me up a bit.

story.text: 저 앞에 서 있는 놈, 니한테 자꾸 말 걸라카는 거 '눈치챘나'?
story.reading: jeo ap-e seo it-neun nom, ni-han-te ja-kku mal geol-la-ka-neun geo nun-chi-chaen-na?
story.en: That guy standing over there — did you notice he keeps trying to talk to you?

story.text: 아까부터 계속 니 쪽 보는 거 '신경 쓰여가' 혼났다.
story.reading: a-kka-bu-teo gye-sok ni jjok bo-neun geo sin-gyeong sseu-yeo-ga hon-nat-da.
story.en: He's been looking your way this whole time, it's been bugging me.

story.text: '괜스레' 기분이 나빠지는 게, 이거 와이라노 진짜. 에엥, 내가 와 이라지?
story.reading: gwaen-seu-re gi-bun-i na-ppa-ji-neun ge, i-geo wa-i-ra-no jin-jja. e-eng, nae-ga wa i-ra-ji?
story.en: For no reason I'm getting annoyed, seriously what is this. Eh— why am I like this?

story.text: 야, 딴 놈 그래 '쳐다보지' 마라. 내 옆에 딱 붙어 있어라.
story.reading: ya, ttan nom geu-rae chyeo-da-bo-ji ma-ra. nae yeop-e ttak but-eo it-eo-ra.
story.en: Hey, don't go staring at other guys like that. Just stick right beside me.

story.text: 이거 무슨 '소유욕'이고 뭐고, 그냥... 니가 다른 놈 보는 게 진짜 싫— 아, 아니다, 아무것도 아이다. 밥이나 무러 가자.
story.reading: i-geo mu-seun so-yu-yok-i-go mwo-go, geu-nyang... ni-ga da-reun nom bo-neun ge jin-jja sil— a, a-ni-da, a-mu-geot-do a-i-da. bap-i-na mu-reo ga-ja.
story.en: This isn't possessiveness or whatever, I just... really hate it when you look at other guys— ah, never mind, it's nothing. Let's go eat.

story.text: 단어 다 익혔제? 이번에도 대화 상황 문제 있으니까 잘 읽고 맞혀봐라.
story.reading: dan-eo da ig-hyeot-je? i-beon-e-do dae-hwa sang-hwang mun-je it-eu-ni-kka jal ilg-go mach-yeo-bwa-ra.
story.en: Got all the words down? This time there's a conversation question too, so read carefully and figure it out.

words.meaning: To be bothered or concerned about something

words.example_en: For no reason, I felt uneasy.
He stared at me for a long while.
He's a person with a subtly strong possessive streak.

sentences.ko: 나는 그의 표정에서 뭔가 이상한 걸 눈치챘다.
sentences.reading: na-neun geu-ui pyo-jeong-e-seo mwon-ga i-sang-han geol nun-chi-chaet-da
sentences.en: I noticed something strange in his expression.

sentences.ko: 자꾸 그 사람이 신경 쓰여서 집중이 안 됐다.
sentences.reading: ja-kku geu sa-ram-i sin-gyeong sseu-yeo-seo jip-jung-i an dwaet-da
sentences.en: I couldn't concentrate because that person kept bothering my mind.
I felt uneasy for no reason, so I left the spot.
He kept staring at the stranger.
It was a moment when his possessiveness was subtly felt.

turns.speaker: 다른 남자
turns.text: 저기, 혹시 사진 좀 같이 찍어도 될까요? 너무 예쁘셔서요.
turns.reading: jeo-gi, hok-si sa-jin jom gat-i jjig-eo-do doel-kka-yo? neo-mu ye-ppeu-syeo-seo-yo.
turns.en: Excuse me, could I take a photo with you? You're so pretty.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Oh, I guess that's fine with me...

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 죄송한데예, 이 사람 저랑 일행입니다. 다른 데 가서 찍으이소.
turns.reading: joe-song-han-de-ye, i sa-ram jeo-rang il-haeng-im-ni-da. da-reun de ga-seo jjig-eu-i-so.
turns.en: Sorry, but this person is with me. Please go take photos somewhere else.

dialogues.question: 선우는 왜 갑자기 대화에 끼어들었나요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo suddenly interrupt the conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 다른 남자가 승객에게 관심을 보이는 게 신경 쓰여서
options: 다른 남자가 승객에게 관심을 보이는 게 신경 쓰여서
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 다른 남자가 승객에게 접근하는 것이 신경 쓰여 은근히 질투하며 끼어들었습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 니는 와 모르는 사람한테 그래 예민하게 구노.
turns.reading: ni-neun wa mo-reu-neun sa-ram-han-te geu-rae ye-min-ha-ge gu-no.
turns.en: Why are you being so sensitive about a total stranger.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 예민한 게 아이고... 그냥 딴 놈이 니 쳐다보는 게 싫— 아이, 신경 쓰인다고, 그냥.
turns.reading: ye-min-han ge a-i-go... geu-nyang ttan nom-i ni chyeo-da-bo-neun ge sil— a-i, sin-gyeong sseu-in-da-go, geu-nyang.
turns.en: It's not that I'm sensitive... I just hate it when other guys look at you— no, I mean it bugs me, that's all.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 방금 딴 말 하려다가 멈췄제? 뭐라 캐려고 했는데?
turns.reading: bang-geum ttan mal ha-ryeo-da-ga meom-chwot-je? mwo-ra kae-ryeo-go haet-neun-de?
turns.en: You just stopped yourself mid-sentence, right? What were you about to say?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 몰라도 된다, 그런 거! 아 됐다 마, 얼굴 뜨거버서 안 되겠다. 자, 회나 사줄 테니까 딴생각 마라.
turns.reading: mol-la-do doen-da, geu-reon geo! a dwaet-da ma, eol-gul tteu-geo-beo-seo an doe-get-da. ja, hoe-na sa-jul te-ni-kka ttan-saeng-gak ma-ra.
turns.en: You don't need to know that! Ugh, forget it, my face is too hot for this. Here, I'll buy you raw fish, so don't think too much.

dialogues.question: 선우가 갑자기 말을 멈추고 화제를 돌린 이유는 무엇일까요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo suddenly stop mid-sentence and change the subject?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 질투 섞인 진심이 무심코 튀어나올 뻔하자 당황해서 얼굴이 붉어지고 서둘러 화제를 돌립니다.
